issues.detail: The Hebrew phrase 'עָרֵי הַכִּכָּר' means 'cities of the plain' (referring to the Jordan Valley/plain), but the Chinese renders it as '餅塊的城' ('cities of the cake/loaf'), which is a mistranslation of 'הַכִּכָּר' (the plain/valley) as '餅塊' (cake/loaf). This changes the meaning of the verse.
